verdict.rationale: Asking about official SDKs is a fair question for an open-source app with a sync server, but the evidence documents no SDK. The only programmatic surfaces are an official export CLI, a search deep link and an llms.txt, and OpenAPI probes returned 404. A CLI and deep links are adjacent tooling, not SDKs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
